result.topic_en: Sine relations among the six angles formed by lines from a fourth point to three given points, used to solve the Pothenot (resection) problem, with a quadrilateral relation giving the criterion of physical possibility.

methods.what: Sine identities among six angles at a fourth point relative to three given points (nine equations by permutation)
Rewriting of the identities in terms of triangle angles A,B,C and observed angles
Definitions relating numbered angles to A,B,C and Fraktur angles
Solving the Pothenot (resection) problem: each equation has two unknowns of known sum
